chart.programText:
A = data('gloo_mesh_redis_sync_err', filter=filter('k8s.namespace.name', 'gloo-mesh')).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name']).publish(label='A')
B = data('gloo_mesh_redis_relation_err', filter=filter('k8s.namespace.name', 'gloo-mesh')).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name']).publish(label='B')
C = data('gloo_mesh_redis_write_time_sec_sum', filter=filter('k8s.namespace.name', 'gloo-mesh')).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name']).publish(label='C')
